posture: C1 -- is the US equity cross-section tail-dominated too?
declared_before: any effect statistic was computed or read
question: At tradeable horizons (1d/21d/252d), in a liquid US equity universe that INCLUDES delisted names, does the MEDIAN name track the EW-MEAN basket, or is the return tail-dominated as in crypto?

crypto_reference.panel: Binance USD-M perps, 919 symbols incl. delisted, 2221 days, qv>=$1M/day

gate1_coverage_minimums.g1a_survivorship: >=20% of panel symbols must cease trading before the panel end date (point-in-time universe, delisted names present)
gate1_coverage_minimums.g1c_breadth: liquid subset holds >=400 names on >=90% of sessions
gate1_coverage_minimums.g1d_integrity: daily close present on >=95% of each name's in-universe sessions
gate1_coverage_minimums.on_failure: declare sample insufficient; report every number as an upper bound or REFUSE

gate2_power.note: MDE computed from dispersion only, BEFORE the effect mean is read
gate2_power.estimator_a: name-day returns; DEFF = 1 + (nbar-1)*ICC; n_eff = n_obs/DEFF; MDE = (z0.95+z0.80)*SD/sqrt(n_eff)
gate2_power.estimator_b: per-date gap series g_t = EWmean_t - median_t; MDE = (z0.95+z0.80)*SD(g)/sqrt(T)

gate3_effect.method: cluster bootstrap by DATE, 5000 draws, seed 20260903
statistics: compound EW vs compound median at 1d/21d/252d
share of total return from top 1% and top 5% of names

kill_lines_declared_in_advance.VIABLE_name_selection_has_a_home: gap point estimate < 0.1427 pp/day (25% of crypto) AND bootstrap CI upper bound < 0.25 pp/day AND 252d median name compound return > 0
kill_lines_declared_in_advance.DEAD_do_not_pick_names_is_universal: bootstrap CI lower bound on the gap >= 0.2854 pp/day (50% of crypto)

control_rule: the median is a MEASUREMENT here, never a benchmark; the only benchmark is the EW mean of the investable universe
economics: net of a sourced realistic US equity round trip; edge/cost ratio stated explicitly
